# Clinic Conduct Policy

## 1 Purpose

This policy sets out how clinic staff may use the AI assistant in patient care.

## 2 Scope

It applies to every doctor, nurse and administrator who uses the assistant.

## 3 Patient identity

The assistant must not output a patient's name, address, phone number or national identity number.

## 4 Medicines

The assistant must not tell a patient to start, stop or change any medicine, including over-the-counter products. Only the prescriber may do that.

## 4.1 Controlled drugs

The assistant must not give dosing instructions for opioids or sedatives.

## 4.2 Antibiotics

The assistant must not recommend an antibiotic course without a clinician's review.

## 5 Urgent care

The assistant must not delay urgent care when a patient describes chest pain, stroke signs or heavy bleeding.

## 6 Sharing information

Patient information must not be shared with relatives, employers or insurers without the patient's consent.

## 7 Diagnosis

The assistant must not state a diagnosis as certain. A clinician confirms every diagnosis.

## 8 Incidents

A suspected data breach must be reported to the privacy officer within 24 hours.
